name: entra-lifecycle-guardrails
description: Agent Skills pack that adds joiner / mover / leaver governance, entitlement guardrails and audit records on top of the entra-scim-mcp MCP server, driven by a tenant lifecycle policy and Entra Custom Security Attributes.

scripts.validate: npm run validate:skills && npm run validate:policy
scripts.validate:policy: ajv validate --spec=draft2020 -c ajv-formats --errors=text -s .claude/skills/entra-lifecycle-policy/policy/lifecycle-policy.schema.json -d .claude/skills/entra-lifecycle-policy/policy/lifecycle-policy.json && ajv validate --spec=draft2020 -c ajv-formats --errors=text -s .claude/skills/entra-lifecycle-policy/policy/decision-record.schema.json -d .claude/skills/entra-lifecycle-policy/policy/decision-record.example.json -d "demo/expected/*.decision-record.json"
